import json, time, sys, os
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/submit'); sys.path.insert(0,'/app/tmp')
os.environ['SCAMP_CORE']='/app/submit/build/scamp_core_5f80e582868b6efd.so'
import main as M, ref
req=json.load(open('/app/tmp/bigfib.json'))
fib=[M.parse_prefix(r['prefix'])+(r['hop'],) for r in req['fib']]
nets=[f[0] for f in fib]; lens=[f[1] for f in fib]; hops=[f[2] for f in fib]
o=sorted(range(len(nets)), key=lambda i:(nets[i],lens[i]))
nets=[nets[i] for i in o]; lens=[lens[i] for i in o]; hops=[hops[i] for i in o]
t=time.time(); res=M.core_compile(nets,lens,req['capacities'],req['max_stride']); print('core_compile %.2fs'%(time.time()-t), res[0] if res else None)
cuts=res[0]
t=time.time(); st,used=M.compute_layout(nets,lens,hops,cuts,None); print('compute_layout %.2fs'%(time.time()-t), used[:5])
t=time.time(); img=M.serialize_image(req['capacities'],req['max_stride'],cuts,st,used,(1,2)); print('serialize %.2fs'%(time.time()-t))
s=json.dumps(img,separators=(',',':')); print('json MB', len(s)/1e6)
